key_notes: Key 1 (t=4.15s): Initial archival pose of harp; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=5.28s): Mid-sequence articulation of harp; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=6.51s): Peak dynamic extension of harp over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.75s): Follow-through and settle of harp with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of harp (4.15s..7.75s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
